direct_claims: 27 file digests match registered index or BC summary and selection freeze.
Internal algorithm/seed match; all 24 PPO/Q completed_new_episodes match the four registered positions.
All saved model/target/support tensor keys, float32 shapes and finite values match the frozen architecture.
Every Q support scoring path exactly matches only its own initialization BC; its full support state also matches that BC.
Every Q bound and history exactly equals independent recomputation from 512 shared demonstration archives plus its own executed training prefix.
Saved configuration/units and required loader fields structurally match the frozen deployment readers.
not_verified: No model construction, load_state_dict, optimizer restoration, selection action, forward pass, environment or new fixture was executed; actual deployed behavior is not tested by this review.
Checkpoint metadata and tensor comparison do not alone prove independent random training, the correctness of every gradient, or causality of any performance change.
BC zero new episodes is directly bound through its summary; BC checkpoints do not embed completed_new_episodes, network_config, or reward-unit fields.
PPO t0/failure_penalty are embedded; gamma=1 and absence of terminal N from features are source contracts, not dedicated PPO checkpoint fields.

Clock extrema were recomputed for provenance, but source-level gate uses finite physical [0,1] with 1e-6 tolerance for global features 6 and 14; their empirical extrema are not deployment rejection thresholds.
BC/PPO sampling RNG structure was checked without calling set_state; generator-state acceptance and resumed learning behavior were not exercised.
Compressed/content hashes bind bytes to the saved ledgers, not to an independently witnessed physical execution.
No selection performance, final-test generalization or official simulator result is certified.

Exact extrema/history agreement establishes consistency with the authorized shared-demo plus own-training rule; it does not by itself disprove unlogged external reads that leave no observable change to these values.
